symptoms: Dark, water-soaked necrotic lesions on leaves and petioles

Overhead sprinkler irrigation extending leaf wetness duration

treatment: Apply Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate M8) @ 2.5 g/L immediately
Spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L on alternate 7-day intervals
Destroy and deeply bury severely infected tomato foliage
prevention: Plant certified resistant varieties (e.g. Arka Rakshak, Mountain Magic)
Use drip irrigation under plastic mulch to eliminate leaf splashing
Ensure 60 cm row spacing for optimal air circulation

symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric target-board rings

prevention: Follow a 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae family
Maintain balanced soil nutrition with high potassium levels
Solarize soil between harvest cycles
